about_the_game:
Overview

Alterra started as a simple idea. What if you could explore the real Earth inside a game? Every mountain, desert and ocean you see is built from real world data, shaped to feel alive and endless.

Gameplay

Right now it is simple. You can move freely, climb hills, fly over valleys or just stop and look around. There are no objectives or missions, only you and the planet.

Future Plans

Over time Alterra will grow. I want to add things like natural disasters, survival elements and multiplayer so people can explore together.

Vision

It is still early, but that is part of the fun. Alterra is meant to be a peaceful space to wander, learn and watch a digital Earth come to life.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 chip or Intel Core i5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple GPU (M1)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game uses GPU compute shaders extensively. Apple Silicon systems are recommended for best performance.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 Pro or Intel Core i7 (6-core or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 Pro GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 64 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game uses GPU compute shaders extensively. Apple Silicon systems are recommended for best performance.

short_description: Explore a living recreation of Earth built from real world data. Travel across mountains, seas and deserts without limits. Alterra invites you to see the planet from a new perspective, free of objectives and full of calm.
